novel_features.name: Provenance-bearing regimen snapshot
novel_features.description: Combines the current stack and one dated provider schedule into deterministic JSON while preserving nutrient relationships and separate observation times.
novel_features.rationale: A raw endpoint mirror cannot safely discard unrelated profile fields, validate overlapping component graphs, and record a two-read provenance boundary for a later canonical importer.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent needs a bounded import candidate rather than raw SuppCo account payloads.

narrative.headline: Read-only SuppCo stack facts with a deterministic, provenance-bearing regimen snapshot export.
narrative.value_prop: Read minimum SuppCo stack and schedule facts, preserve overlapping nutrient relationships, and emit a deterministic snapshot for a later importer. Periodic bearer-token replacement is the intentionally simple authentication model.
narrative.auth_narrative: Provide a current bearer token through SUPPCO_ACCESS_TOKEN or pipe it to auth set-token. If it expires, replace it; automatic refresh and browser automation are not part of this package.

quickstart.comment: Project the minimum current product identity fields.
Inspect parent and component relationships without summing overlap.
Build a dated normalized import candidate with provenance.

troubleshoots.symptom: SuppCo rejects the request as unauthenticated
troubleshoots.fix: Replace the periodic bearer token through SUPPCO_ACCESS_TOKEN or pipe a new value to suppco-pp-cli auth set-token.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for read-only extraction of a SuppCo stack, nutrient relationships, or provider schedule. Use the regimen snapshot when a later importer needs deterministic JSON with explicit provenance.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to edit SuppCo, log intake, calculate nutrient exposure, or make health recommendations.
Do not use this CLI to capture cookies, browser sessions, or raw account payloads.
